prose: Short note from feed metadata only: Bloomberg (Bailey Lipschultz) reads Anthropic's S-1 and reports third-quarter revenue up 12x year over year to nearly $17 billion, a net loss of $23.3 billion (up from $12.1 billion in Q3 2025), and operating expenses up 292 percent to $17.5 billion. The source is paywalled, so the figures are as the feed reports them; the tilomitra charts piece linked nearby walks through the filing's structure, including why most of the headline loss is a fair-value accounting entry rather than cash burn.
highlights: Bloomberg on Anthropic's S-1: Q3 revenue ~$17B, up 12x YoY
Net loss $23.3B (vs $12.1B a year earlier); opex up 292% to $17.5B
Paywalled; see the linked charts piece for the filing's structure
Headline loss is mostly a fair-value accounting entry, not cash
